title: Demo: The First Year After Graduation
persona: Zhou, 23, six months out of college, living alone and working their first job in a big city. Evenings usually slip away scrolling on their phone and ordering takeout—sitting too long, sleeping too late. Their curiosity is still very much alive, they just aren't sure where to direct their energy yet.
guide: This is a demo template showing how Sin90 works: each of the six life areas features a 'Now → Ideal' vision, a guiding direction, and a 3-year goal. This year's goals break down into quarterly and monthly milestones; weekly rhythms are sustained with daily routines; and today starts with three small, actionable tasks. You can edit this template directly into your own plan, or clear everything under 'Data' to start from scratch. A backup is created automatically before any changes, so you can restore at any time.

areas.title: Work
areas.current_state: Less than a year into the job, relying on overtime to compensate for inexperience; doing plenty of tasks, but nothing tangible to show for it yet.
areas.ideal_state: Become the go-to person the team can always rely on in one core area, with 3 standout portfolio pieces under your belt.

directions.title: Build portable core skills: structured communication + one hard skill
directions.goal_3y: In 3 years: lead a complete project end-to-end, with a public portfolio of 3 substantial projects

years.target: Master the fundamentals: write a monthly work retrospective, and learn one hard skill (e.g. SQL / Python for data analysis)
Lead a small project from initial requirements to final launch
Own a full-scale project independently, bringing the portfolio count to 3

quarter.target: Get comfortable with the basics of the hard skill, build your first mini-project, and write a retrospective on it

month.target: Protect three 90-minute blocks of uninterrupted deep work each week

areas.title: Health
areas.current_state: Sitting at a desk all day, living on takeout, staying up until 1 AM, and getting winded climbing a few flights of stairs.
areas.ideal_state: Consistent sleep schedule, weekly strength training, eating mostly whole foods, and enjoying steady energy all day long.

directions.title: Build a physical foundation that lasts a lifetime: Sleep · Strength · Nutrition
directions.goal_3y: In 3 years: sleep consistently at 23:30 and wake at 7:30; barbell squat your bodyweight; complete a 10 km run; keep body fat in a healthy range

years.target: Stick to resistance training twice a week for 40 weeks; master four foundational movements: squat, glute bridge, push-up, and row
Strength training 3 times a week + 150 minutes of moderate cardio weekly; start running regularly
Complete a 10 km run, and squat your own bodyweight

quarter.target: Strength train twice a week, hit 8,000 steps a day; adopt the eating order: veggies first, protein second, carbs last

month.target: Complete 8 strength sessions; hit daily protein target of body weight (kg) × 1.2–1.6 g (about 70–100 g for 60 kg)

areas.title: Learning
areas.current_state: Spending 2–3 hours on short videos every day; occasionally picking up a book, only to forget it right after.
areas.ideal_state: Have your own personal knowledge map: a solid grasp of AI, philosophy, history, and art—read a book, write a reflection.

directions.title: Cultivate a lifelong habit of 'Input → Output'
directions.goal_3y: In 3 years: read 36 books, write 36 reading reflections, and map out your personal mental model across AI, philosophy, history, and art

years.target: Read 12 books, write 12 reflections: 3 in each of the 4 areas (AI: build a hands-on mini tool with AI; Philosophy: Sophie's World, Meditations; History: Sapiens, A History of the World; Art: The Story of Art)
Read another 12 books, organizing the 12 reflections into 4 themed public essays
Read 12 more books, finalize all 4 knowledge maps, and give a talk or share them publicly

quarter.target: Read 3 books and write 3 reflections; visit an art gallery or museum once a month

month.target: Read 30 minutes every day; finish 1 book and write 1 reflection

areas.title: Relationships
areas.current_state: Friends scattered after graduation, barely exchanging a few words a week with family, and conversations with colleagues never leave work.
areas.ideal_state: Have 3–5 close confidants you can talk deeply with, stay warmly connected with family, and remain open to meeting new people.

directions.title: Nurture fewer, deeper connections intentionally
directions.goal_3y: In 3 years: have 5 close friends you can confide in, call family weekly, and meet 10 intriguing new friends each year

years.target: Reach out to 1 person intentionally each week, and meet up in person once a month
Join an interest-based community and make 10 new friends
Have a meaningful, in-depth catchup with each of your 5 close friends once a quarter

quarter.target: Reach out 12 times, meet up in person 3 times

month.target: Call home every Sunday evening; catch up with an old friend over a meal

areas.title: Wealth
areas.current_state: Living paycheck to paycheck, never tracking expenses, with no emergency fund.
areas.ideal_state: Steady income growth, a 6-month living expense emergency cushion, and consistent long-term investing.

directions.title: Set up the four-account money system: Daily Living · Emergency · Investments · Primary Account
directions.goal_3y: In 3 years: 6 months of living expenses saved in emergency funds, 20% of monthly income saved reliably, and 24 consecutive months of index fund DCA investing

years.target: Track spending for 12 months, building up a 3-month living expense emergency fund
Grow the emergency cushion to 6 months, then start monthly index fund DCA investing
Maintain index fund DCA for 24 months straight, doing an annual review of your net worth curve

quarter.target: Set up the four separate accounts, automating a 20% transfer the day your paycheck hits

month.target: Track expenses for 30 consecutive days, reviewing at month-end to see where your money really went

areas.title: Exploration & Creation
areas.current_state: Evenings are lost to scrolling feeds; it's been a long time since you made something simply because you wanted to.
areas.ideal_state: Have a meaningful long-term personal project, steadily express your creative voice, and stay eager to try things you've never done before.

directions.title: Finish one original piece of work every quarter
directions.goal_3y: In 3 years: finish 12 personal creations (writing, photography, coding tools, music all count!), and share at least 6 of them publicly

years.target: Complete 4 creations—one each quarter; try one brand-new experience every month
Complete 4 more pieces, sharing at least 2 publicly
Complete 4 more pieces, putting together a showcase or releasing a collection

quarter.target: Complete 1 creative piece (e.g. a street photography series, or a simple webpage)

month.target: Carve out 2 uninterrupted hours every Saturday morning for creative work, rain or shine

routines.title: 90 minutes of morning deep work on weekdays
45-minute strength workout (Squat · Glute Bridge · Push-up · Row)
Read for 30 minutes before bed (phone left in the living room)
2 hours of creative time on Saturday morning

today.title: Head over to the Directions tab, read through the examples, and tweak one 3-year goal to fit your life
Complete your first 45-minute strength session (follow along with a workout video if you're new)
Send a friendly text to an old friend you haven't spoken with in a while

inbox: Visit an art exhibition this weekend
Pick the book to read this month
